name: Love God
overview: Scripture reveals that God's love is the foundation of our salvation, demonstrated supremely through the giving of His only Son so that believers may have eternal life, as shown in John 3:16. Romans 5:8 emphasizes that God's love is unconditional and active, commending His love by Christ's sacrificial death for sinners. Galatians 2:20 highlights the believer’s response to this love, living a life sustained by faith in the Son of God who loved and gave Himself for us.
